scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run start:api" "npm run start:client:fast" "npm run start:admin"
scripts.start:tabs: start cmd /k "cd laravel-api && php artisan serve" && start cmd /k "cd nuxt-app && npm run dev:fast" && start cmd /k "cd laravel-api/resources/nuxt-ui && npm run dev"
scripts.start:client:fast: cd nuxt-app && set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=16384 && npm run dev
scripts.start:client:turbo: cd nuxt-app && set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=16384 && npm run dev:fast
scripts.start:client:clean: cd nuxt-app && rmdir /s /q .nuxt 2>nul && set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=16384 && npm run dev:fast
scripts.build:api: cd laravel-api && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:admin && npm run build:api
scripts.install:all: cd laravel-api && composer install && cd ../nuxt-app && npm install && cd ../laravel-api/resources/nuxt-ui && npm install
scripts.fresh: npm run install:all && npm run dev:clean
